auditor_value: Only when the projectile is launched from and lands on the same horizontal level (zero net vertical displacement), with g constant and air resistance neglected.
notes: Matches my answer. One refinement, not filed as a finding: step 1 correctly says H = u²sin²θ/(2g) comes from vᵧ = 0 at the top, so H measured above the launch point holds for any landing level provided the peak is reached; the same-level condition is what T and R need. As a statement about the three formulas used together, step 4 is true.
